$description: SocialPaint design tokens exported from the Figma file "Master UX-UI New Brand Eleven Labs Inspired" (dQ8bQq3V7Bue5pvFrI2g9X). This file is the source for src/styles/tokens.css. Do not edit values here by hand: change the Figma variables or styles, re-export, then run `npm run tokens`.

source.name: Master UX-UI New Brand Eleven Labs Inspired

surface/page.description: The app background behind every panel.

surface/raised.description: Panels, menus, popovers and dialogs. Matches the page in Light, so the edge comes from border/raised.

surface/sunken.description: Wells inside a raised surface, like the canvas or a sent message.

surface/field.description: Inputs, selects, text areas and upload fields.

surface/inverse.description: The selected Chip and Platform Chip, and other inverted fills.

surface/overlay.description: Tags and labels that sit on an image or graphic. Dark in both themes.

text/secondary.description: Supporting text, placeholders and quiet icons.

text/disabled.description: Text and icons on disabled controls.

text/on-color.description: Text and icons on surface/overlay and other fills that stay dark in both themes.

border/strong.description: Outlines that need to read as an edge.

border/control.description: The edge of a checkbox, radio or switch that is off. Passes 3:1.

border/raised.description: The edge of panels, cards, menus and dialogs.

action/on-primary.description: Text and icons on the primary button.

action/neutral.description: Fill of the neutral button. Works on the page and on raised surfaces, so one neutral button covers both.

action/accent.description: The send button and other single accent actions.

action/on-accent.description: Text and icons on an accent action.

action/danger.description: Fill of destructive buttons, like delete.

action/on-danger.description: Text and icons on a danger button.

state/hover.description: Hover on rows, ghost buttons and menu items.

state/selected.description: The current row, item or nav entry.

state/pressed.description: Rows, ghost buttons and menu items while pressed.

control/track.description: The track of a segmented control.

control/thumb.description: The selected segment and the switch thumb.

control/on.description: A switch that is on, a checked checkbox or radio.

control/on-mark.description: The check or dot inside a checked control.

status/positive-text.description: Text and dot on a positive badge.

status/active-text.description: Text and dot on an active badge.

status/neutral-surface.description: Fill of neutral badges, default tags and alerts.

feedback/error.description: Error icons and the edge of a field in an error state.

feedback/error-surface.description: Fill of an error badge or alert.

feedback/error-text.description: Error messages and text on feedback/error-surface.

feedback/warning.description: Warning icons and the edge of a field that needs attention.

feedback/warning-surface.description: Fill of a warning badge or alert.

feedback/warning-text.description: Warning messages and text on feedback/warning-surface.

editor/selection.description: Selection handles and outlines on the canvas.

accent/green.description: SocialPaint green for charts, trends and brand moments. Keep interface chrome on the gray tokens.

deep/green.description: Deep SocialPaint green for brand moments and template content.

tint/green.description: Light SocialPaint green for brand moments and template content.

accent/blue.description: SocialPaint blue for charts and brand moments.

deep/blue.description: Deep SocialPaint blue for brand moments and template content.

tint/blue.description: Light SocialPaint blue for brand moments and template content.

accent/pink.description: SocialPaint pink for charts and brand moments.

deep/pink.description: Deep SocialPaint pink for brand moments and template content.

tint/pink.description: Light SocialPaint pink for brand moments and template content.

accent/warm.description: SocialPaint orange for charts and brand moments.

deep/warm.description: Deep SocialPaint brown for brand moments and template content.

tint/warm.description: Light SocialPaint peach for brand moments and template content.

accent/purple.description: SocialPaint violet for charts and brand moments.

deep/purple.description: Deep SocialPaint purple for brand moments and template content.

tint/purple.description: Light SocialPaint lilac for brand moments and template content.

wash/green.description: Pale green background for template content.

wash/warm.description: Pale cream background for template content.

shadow/raised.description: Transparent. Raised surfaces sit flat and take their edge from border/raised.

shadow/floating.description: Shadow under menus, popovers and toasts.

shadow/thumb.description: Shadow under the switch thumb and the selected segment.

bevel/top.description: Transparent, since this system draws no bevels. Kept so the elevation styles keep the same layers in code.

bevel/bottom.description: Transparent, since this system draws no bevels. Kept so the elevation styles keep the same layers in code.

glow/accent.description: Transparent, since this system draws no glow. Kept so Glow/Accent still resolves in code.

surface/shell.description: The app shell behind the sidebar and the main area.

surface/card.description: Template, result and content cards on the page.

surface/stage.description: The stage behind a template preview.

surface/soft.description: Icon tiles, segmented control tracks, the count stepper, progress tracks and pending progress steps.

border/field.description: The edge of inputs, selects, text areas and upload fields.

plate/dark.description: The dark ground a logo is proofed on. Stays dark in both themes.

plate/light.description: The light ground a logo is proofed on. Stays light in both themes.

border/field-hover.description: The edge of a field under the pointer, one step darker than border/field.

logo/ink.description: The SocialPaint lockup and its mark. Near-black on Light and off-white on Dark, the colors of the two lockup files.

radius/sm.description: Buttons, fields, menu items and other controls.

radius/md.description: Thumbnails and wells inside a card, tooltips and alerts.

size/control-sm.description: Compact controls in toolbars and inspectors.

size/control-md.description: The default height for buttons, fields and rows.

size/control-lg.description: Sign-in forms and other primary moments.

size/icon-sm.description: Icons inside chips, tags and compact controls.

size/icon-md.description: The default icon size in buttons, fields, menus and navigation.

focus/offset.description: Gap between a control and its focus ring.

motion/duration/instant.description: No transition. Use for reduced motion and immediate state changes.

motion/duration/pulse.description: One cycle of the skeleton pulse and the indeterminate progress bar.

radius/chip.description: Chips, search fields and option tiles.

radius/tile.description: Icon tiles inside chips and option tiles.

radius/shell.description: Corners of the sidebar shell. 0, so the sidebar runs flush to the window.

layout/shell-inset.description: Gap around and between the sidebar and the main area. 0, so the panels sit flush.

stroke/shell-edge.description: Top, left and bottom edges of the sidebar. 0, so only the right edge shows.

radius/composer.description: The chat composer, so the one-line bar reads as a pill and the taller bar keeps soft corners.
